results.title: Paraguay 2026 World Cup Preview: Squad, Schedule, Odds & Best Bets
highlights:
Paraguay returns to the FIFA World Cup after a 16-year absence, relying on a robust and experienced defence under manager Gustavo Alfaro. Their qualification was built on low-scoring, disciplined performances, making them tough opponents. While strong at the back and equipped with Premier League talent in Diego Gomez and exciting attackers like Julio Enciso, expectations of a lengthy run are low. Still, Paraguay could surprise in Group D against USA, Turkey, and Australia, with value in betting on low-scoring games rather than an outright win.

Their qualifying numbers tell the story cleanly. Paraguay scored just 14 goals in 18 matches, the lowest total of any automatic qualifier from South America. They also conceded only 10 times, comfortably one of the top three defensive records in CONMEBOL. They were not trying to outscore anyone. They were trying to make it almost impossible for anyone to outscore them. That approach, carried into a World Cup group with the United States, Australia and Turkiye, gives them a very real path to the Round of 32 through two manageable results rather than three.

Group A Best Bet to Win: Mexico -125 (DraftKings)
[...]
If there's one of the three North American teams that's going to have a significant home-field advantage in this World Cup, it's Mexico. Their rabid fans and forcing their opponents to play in an uncomfortable environment at 7,300 feet is going to give them a significant edge. Of course, the fact that they have a relatively easy group is the main reason they're favored at -140. Let's not overthink this one.
[...]
### Group D Odds to Win
[...]
- USA +130
- Turkiye +180
- Paraguay +400
- Australia +800
[...]
Group D Best Bet to Win: Paraguay +400 (BetMGM)
[...]
Paraguay plays a frustratingly defensive style of soccer, which is going to give them a chance to win or draw any and every game in the Group Stage. The United States once again enters the tournament overvalued in the betting market, and I'm not sold on them having a significant home-field advantage. Turkiye is going to be a popular pick to come out of this group, but I have to take a few shots on some dark horses in this article, and I love what Paraguay has to offer at 4-1.
